text:
ida (Design): quick question  should account-create show inline errors while typing or wait and show a compact top summary after submit? also what to do for required flags  asterisk vs explicit label? link to tiny mock: https://drive.redwood.design/ux/account-mini.png

sam (PM): inline for immediate fixes, top summary if submit fails with several errors. keeps UX friendly. :+1:

marta (A11y): inline OK but must be announced (aria-live). asterisk alone is not enough for screen readers  add sr-only '(required)' or aria-required. move focus to summary on reveal.

ryan (Frontend): doable. pattern: inline on blur, role=alert for summary with anchors to fields. will attach aria-describedby for server errors.

noel (Eng): for destructive flows (delete org) I prefer typed-confirm (exact name) + server-side idempotency. item deletes = modal + undo toast.

ops-bot: accessibility-check: required sr-only labels recommended; role=alert + focus management; color contrast check.

ida (Design): decision: inline as-you-type for field constraints; on submit if >1 errors reveal compact summary (up to 4 bullets) with anchor links. required = visible asterisk + sr-only 'required'. delete flow = typed-confirm for org, modal+undo for items. i'll update mocks and tag @marta for audit. sync tomorrow 10:00am.
